name: biztecheg/easy-pdf-word
description: Generate PDF and Word documents in plain PHP, in any language, with first-class Arabic support (RTL, shaping, numerals, tafqeet, Hijri dates) and ready-made templates. No framework needed.

suggest.mpdf/mpdf: Default PDF engine: pure PHP, native Arabic shaping and bidi (GPL-2.0).
suggest.spatie/browsershot: Chromium PDF engine via Puppeteer, highest rendering quality.
suggest.phpoffice/phpword: Word (.docx) output: Arabic right-to-left documents and Word-designed templates.
suggest.ext-curl: Gotenberg engine (the Chromium engine as a service).
suggest.ext-intl: Required for Hijri dates and locale-aware number formatting.
suggest.ext-zip: Required for Word files and ZIP archives.
suggest.biztecheg/laravel-easy-pdf-word: The Laravel package on top of this one: the Doc facade, config, Blade, storage, mail, queues and a preview page.
